# 「遊蕩者」級追緝穿梭機
[color=#a4885c]船隻尺寸：[/color] 中型
[color=#a4885c]艦隊接駁船：[/color] 否
[color=#a4885c]建議船員人數：[/color] 3-4 人
[color=#a4885c]動力生成類型：[/color] 巴納尼姆
[color=#a4885c]遠征任務：[/color] 無
[color=#a4885c]敵我識別（IFF）控制台：[/color] 有
[color=#a4885c]最低存取等級：[/color] 中士
「作為一艘中型巡邏艦，『Prowler』級是專為深空追擊任務設計的艦艇，配備先進的感測器套件，並具備適度的貨艙載運能力。」
# Ship Functions
- 為發電機補充燃料時請務必謹慎，因其會洩漏輻射，若未採取防護措施，可能會造成傷害。
- 駕駛艙內有一個按鈕：那個黃黑相間邊框的按鈕用來控制防爆門。
# 操作 NSF Prowler 穿梭機的要訣 - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold] (kW) 為 [color=#a4885c]32.5 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/].
- For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - For the basics of [bold]cargo hauling[/bold], refer to [textlink="Cargo Hauling" link="CargoHauling"]. - For the basics of [bold]expedition diving[/bold], refer to [textlink="Expeditions" link="Expeditions"]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
